title: MyRouteOnline
description: Multi-stop route optimization, navigation links, and email delivery. Powered by MyRouteOnline.
summary: Multi-stop route optimization, navigation links, and email delivery. Powered by MyRouteOnline.
offersHint: Multi-stop route optimization, navigation links, and email delivery. Powered by MyRouteOnline. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://planner.myrouteonline.com/ws_api_ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: getOneTimeCode
toolsPreview.description: Request a one-time authentication code to be sent via email. This code is required for all other operations.

toolsPreview.name: startOptimization
toolsPreview.description: Start a route optimization job with multiple addresses. Authenticate with either (otpCode + otpEmail) or mroApiKey.

toolsPreview.name: checkOptimization
toolsPreview.description: Check the status and results of a route optimization job. Returns the optimized route when complete. Authenticate with either (otpCode + otpEmail) or mroApiKey.

toolsPreview.name: emailResults
toolsPreview.description: Email the optimized route results with navigation links to a specified email address. Authenticate with either (otpCode + otpEmail) or mroApiKey.
